name: TENET5 QUANTANIUM Design Contract
release_notes: 1.4.0: PRISTINE ICE LAKE. Spec = crystal-clear frozen ice over a lake — looking into water with no bottom. Solid abyssal tokens (#05080d), ice-sheet raised (#0c1219), crystalline chrome (#eef6fa NOT cyan), glacial ink (#a8bcc8). Body paints infinite depth. Glass = thin ice film + frost edge. Banned: muddy greys, gold chrome, neon cyber (#00e5ff/#00ffaa), gradients inside color tokens. 1.3.0 greyscale chrome. 1.2.0 two-font lock.
purpose: Single canonical design-token contract for tenet-5.github.io. Prevents AI/automation theme drift by giving every agent a machine-readable manifest to read BEFORE editing CSS.

canonical_source.rule: Any change to tokens.css MUST recompute this hash. The automated brand guardian rejects mismatches. Run: python tools/liril_brand_guardian.py --update-token-hash

active_palette.label: Pristine Ice Lake
active_palette.spec: crystal clear frozen ice over a lake — looking into crystal clear water with no bottom
active_palette.rationale: Infinite cool depth under a thin transparent ice sheet. Not charcoal mud, not neon cyber, not gold chrome.

osint_dashboard.notes: Ice-lake glass panels; schema-tolerant metrics; threat classes; stale banner >14d.

agentic_demo.role: public_tail_of_prism_os — company/user website maintenance + p256 self-train surface

report_presentation.aesthetic: ice report sheets — frost edge, metric rails, finding chips, rpt-table

prism_os_tail.purpose: Demonstrate agentic systems maintaining a real website; feed local C++ quantum + p256 self-train

load_order_rule: FIXED. Other layers reference tokens via var(); they do NOT redefine :root. inline_generated.css MUST come last so CI can ship rule additions, never token redefinitions.

quantanium_namespace.purpose: Reserved --quantanium-* namespace: status-badge styling tokens. No live data source.

accessibility.purpose: Make the record readable for every IQ and reading ability — including dyslexic and low-vision readers — without stigma or visual contortion.
accessibility.primary_font_default: Atkinson Hyperlegible (Braille Institute, character-distinction sans). Locked as the only non-mono face site-wide per Daniel directive 2026-04-27.

accessible_reading_mode.rationale: Atkinson Hyperlegible was designed by the Braille Institute via low-vision research to differentiate commonly-misinterpreted characters (I/l/1, 0/O, b/d/p/q). Open-licensed via Google Fonts. Stronger empirical backing than OpenDyslexic for general dyslexia + low-vision readers; doubles as a beautiful reading font, eliminating the 'this is the disability mode' stigma.
accessible_reading_mode.tweaks: letter-spacing 0.01em, line-height 1.85, word-spacing 0.05em on body text

canonical.policy: Only place :root tokens are defined. !important is enforced.

legacy_aliases.policy: Forwarding only. Do NOT extend. Do NOT define new aliases. New code must reference canonical --slate-* names.

--slate-critical.use: muted brick — never alarm-red #ef4444 or neon

rules_for_agents: QUANTANIUM is the mature contract — obey tokens.css + this file before any CSS edit
Never add :root hex palette values outside tokens.css
Never resurrect mid-tone brass (#5c6773/#b5835a), oxblood, gold chrome, or neon cyber
brand-lock.css and slate-tokens.css are re-assert/shim only — do not invent a second palette there
Chrome = crystalline ice #eef6fa; colour is for DATA semantics only
Two fonts only: Atkinson Hyperlegible + IBM Plex Mono

--slate-font-sans.use: body + UI + links — the only non-mono face on the site

--slate-font-mono.use: labels, eyebrows, citations, code, footer headers

--slate-font-serif.use: alias only — site uses no serif; slot maps to Atkinson

--slate-font-display.use: display headings — same face as body, weight differentiates

type_scale.policy: Fluid clamp() for the upper register (3xl–6xl), fixed rem for body sizes (xs–2xl).

rules_for_agents: READ /css/tokens.css §1 before adding any new :root token.
DO NOT add :root{} blocks to any file other than /css/tokens.css.
DO NOT introduce a new namespace prefix. Use --slate-* for canonical, alias forward in §2 if migrating an old name.
DO NOT remove !important from canonical tokens — it is the brute-force enforcement against auto-generation overwrites.
DO NOT migrate to oxblood, navy, red-ensign, or any palette other than monochrome-operational-intel without an explicit Daniel directive AND an update to active_palette.id here.
DO recompute canonical_source.sha256 after every edit to /css/tokens.css. tools/liril_brand_guardian rejects mismatches.
DO add new feature tokens to /css/tokens.css §1, then reference via var(--slate-...) in the feature's stylesheet.

checks: live tokens.css sha256 must equal canonical_source.sha256
no other production CSS file may declare :root tokens (audit pass)
ice-lake palette signature: --slate-bg=#05080d and --slate-accent=#eef6fa must resolve in :root (live)

ci.pre_commit_hint: if /css/tokens.css changed, hash must be updated in this file in the same commit

history.author: claude_code

history.author: claude_code
history.change: Rebrand SLATE -> QUANTANIUM contract; reserve --quantanium-* styling namespace; add Atkinson Hyperlegible accessible reading mode toggle.

history.author: claude_code
history.change: TWO-FONT LOCK. Site type pair fixed at Atkinson Hyperlegible (sans/display/links/body) + IBM Plex Mono (mono/labels/footer headers). Both webfonts loaded via single Google Fonts @import — no system-font fallthrough. Stripped Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, system-ui, Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Times New Roman, Space Grotesk, OpenDyslexic, JetBrains Mono, Consolas from --slate-font-* stacks. Daniel directive: 'ensure our website sticks to these 2 fonts'. tokens.css sha256 -> d20c3d068be89f45f63d108f670aa9f9be0d8dc773e6f52a75a66a28605d7ad8.

history.author: claude_code
history.change: PRISTINE ICE LAKE glass theme (Daniel directive from reference mockups). Retired flat #202020 charcoal + gold chrome. Surfaces = solid abyssal ice tokens (#05080d / #0c1219 / #080c11 / #03050a); chrome = crystalline ice-white #eef6fa (monochrome, no cyan/gold); ink = ice-white #f5fafc + glacial silver #a8bcc8. Depth painted on <body> (radial), panels rendered as frosted glass via tnt-override.css (ice-skin fill + frost edge + backdrop-blur). Colour reserved for MUTED data semantics only (never neon). Rewrote tnt-override.css from the charcoal master-override into the ice-glass deliverer. Bumped tokens.css + tnt-override.css to ?v=46 sitewide (323 files). tokens.css sha256 -> a99ef0fe7837751e5122ec8c037dc4dbd49dea8a891e441ebfef153b04f6a23b.
